text: A PC anchor shall be an explicit position in a consuming-object section, allowing its end. Slice extraction shall require an explicit full-address domain. A bitfield shall specify signedness, bit count, destination bit offset, optional anchor, and positive power-of-two scale; the full expression shall be exactly divisible by scale and fit before insertion.
